hooks.name: privacy-audit
hooks.description: Run on demand: asks the privacy-reviewer agent to audit all migrations, policies and server code against privacy.md.

action.prompt: Delegate to the privacy-reviewer sub-agent: audit every file in supabase/migrations, supabase/tests, src/app/api and src/lib against .kiro/steering/privacy.md. Report findings ranked by severity with file and line, and list any privacy rule that has no test. Do not change code; produce the report only.
